stem.text: The radius of the Earth is approximately $6.4 \times 10^{6}\,\text{m}$, and the radius of the Moon is approximately $1.7 \times 10^{6}\,\text{m}$. A student wishes to build a scale model of the Solar System in the classroom, using a football of radius $0.12\,\text{m}$ to represent the Earth.
Which object would best represent the Moon?
